why: The pet already sits back quietly so the painting gets the attention, which is the restraint I want every pet to keep.

veto.quote: anything that upstages the picture or overstays
veto.why: A companion in the corner for a whole painting session would share the light with the canvas and pull the eye away each time it reacts.

style: Every pet stays small and still beside the painting, moves only when it has something to say, then leaves.
making: Worry: separate sessions may drift in size and motion, so the review should check each pet stays small and still beside the picture.
